image_asset.title: Character Comparison Matrix: Mr. Raven vs Reynard the Fox
image_asset.caption: Side-by-side analysis of vanity vs cunning manipulation in Jean de la Fontaine's fable.

hotspots.label: Mr. Raven (Victim)
hotspots.description: Analyzes Mr. Raven's vanity, susceptibility to flattery, and sudden loss of food.
hotspots.interactive_popup_text: Mr. Raven opened his beak to sing 'Caaaw!', dropping his morsel into the Fox's waiting mouth.

hotspots.label: Reynard the Fox (Trickster)
hotspots.description: Details Reynard's strategic flattery regarding the Raven's black plumage and voice.
hotspots.interactive_popup_text: The Fox concluded with a lesson: 'Flatterers live at the expense of those who listen to them.'
